ai.summary: Vapor Panda targeted more than 200 organizations spanning at least 14 countries, according to CrowdStrike. The ongoing campaign is remarkably successful and operating at shocking speed. The post China-backed threat group used agentic AI pentesting tool to compromise 140 sensitive targets in 11 days appeared first on CyberScoop .
ai.title: China-backed threat group used agentic AI pentesting tool to compromise 140 sensitive targets in 11 days

ai.summary: Intel 471 tested a public exploit for the AI-discovered PHP flaws. We found exploitation is hard, but you should still patch now.
ai.title: Testing a PHP2Shell exploit in the era of AI-hallucinated PoCs

ai.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to initiate arbitrary server-side requests on affected installations of MLflow. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.7. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-71211.
ai.title: ZDI-26-847: MLflow AI Gateway Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability

general.summary: A security researcher has released a proof-of-concept exploit for a recently patched Android vulnerability, dubbed "SMS of Death" and tracked as CVE-2026-58882, that lets attackers remotely disrupt cellular service or crash phones by sending a specially crafted text message. [...]
general.title: New Android SMS of Death exploit can remotely crash unpatched phones

general.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles. [...]
general.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"

general.summary: The self-deleting VOLTA infostealer steals credentials, sessions, and cryptocurrency wallets. Then, it uses LLMs to profile victims and rank their most valuable assets.
general.title: Appraisal by AI: Model-driven victim prioritization in the VOLTA infostealer

general.summary: Microsoft analyzes a malicious Claude Code–branded extension, its persistent SSH backdoor, and guidance to detect and remediate it. The post Inside a malicious Claude Code-branded extension and its persistent SSH backdoor appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .
general.title: Inside a malicious Claude Code-branded extension and its persistent SSH backdoor

general.summary: TrendAIは、AIを悪用して日本の組織を狙うサイバー攻撃の調査結果を公開した。44のAIエージェントを連携させ、偵察から脆弱性の悪用、情報窃取までの攻撃工程を自動化する事例などを確認。少なくとも19組織が脆弱性の検証対象となり、このうち16組織以上が日本国内に所在していたという。
general.title: 日本の組織を狙うサイバー攻撃、44のAIエージェントで偵察から情報窃取まで自動化

general.summary: GMOインターネットのVPSサービスへの不正アクセスは、顧客情報の漏えいだけでなく、攻撃者による情報公開、企業の対抗措置、SNSでの真偽不明情報の拡散を招いた。攻撃者が仕掛ける「劇場型」の情報戦に、企業も報道も巻き込まれていないか。SNSをやめたくなった記者が、事件の経緯を振り返りながら考える。
general.title: GMO不正アクセスで“SNSをやめたくなった”　攻撃者の仕掛ける情報戦に企業と報道はどう向き合うべきか？
